title: K-flatness of a strict simultaneous quotient presentation
statement: Fix a prime l, a finite extension E of Q_l and a scheme X. Let P be a cochain complex of module sheaves over the completed integral E coefficient ring, with flat terms and independent-coefficient K-flatness: tensoring P with any acyclic complex is acyclic [def-trf-integral-comparison-realization-models, lem-pur-kflat-change-of-rings-independent]. Let C be a cochain complex on the E quotient-coefficient system site. For every natural number n, suppose an isomorphism kappa_n identifies the nth finite evaluation of C with the ordinary nth quotient extension of P [lem-coef-derived-system-evaluation-calculus]. Then C is independent-coefficient K-flat on the system site: tensoring it with any acyclic system complex is acyclic.

source.place: Definition 3.4.10 and Proposition 3.5.1; Stacks 06YY and 0941. Agent expansion: K-flatness by exact tensor-compatible evaluation and componentwise detection.

proof.text: Quotient coefficient extension preserves independent-coefficient K-flatness of P because its terms are flat. Transport K-flatness through each specified evaluation isomorphism.

Evaluate the tensor of C with any acyclic test complex at every quotient. Evaluation is exact and commutes with tensor products. Every evaluated tensor is acyclic; componentwise detection on the system site implies acyclicity of the original tensor.

theorem scalarPresentationKFlat
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime]
    (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra ℚ_[l] E] [FiniteDimensional ℚ_[l] E]
    (X : Scheme.{u})
    (P : (integralOperationsGoodComplex l E X).FullSubcategory)
    (C : CochainComplex (coefficientSequenceModules l E X) ℤ)
    (κ : ∀ n : ℕ,
      ((coefficientSequenceEvaluation l E X n).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj C ≅
        (unrestrictedIntegralFiniteComplex l E X n).obj P.obj) :
    CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients
      (R := coefficientSequenceCommRingSheaf l E X) C
